title: Ghostly green lakes merge in Australian outback after 2 years of heavy rain — Earth from space
byline: Harry Baker Social Links Navigation Senior Staff Writer
excerpt: A 2024 satellite photo shows a series of ephemeral lakes that merged into a single emerald structure in Australia's Northern Territory following two years of extreme rainfall.
content:
QUICK FACTS

Where is it? Barkly Tableland, Australia's Northern Territory [-18.595019720, 135.2699610]

What's in the photo? A series of ephemeral lakes that have merged into a single body of water

Which satellite took the photo? Landsat 8

When was it taken? Oct. 30, 2024
